model: SKE4 electric steam humidifier (Modbus communication module)
applies_to: Neptronic SKE4 series electric steam humidifiers with the Modbus communication module, guide SKE4-Modbus Guide-240531 (V2.07).
summary: The Neptronic SKE4 is an electric steam humidifier with SSR-driven heater stages. Its Modbus RTU module exposes everything as holding registers: raw signal voltages, scaled readings (room and supply RH, water temperature, currents, demand and output), set points and PID terms, binary inputs and relay states as 0/1 registers, and enumerated control, source and alarm states.

addressing.note: The guide prints a protocol-base (0-based) address and a six-digit holding register (base 400001) side by side, e.g. 6004 / 406005. The protocol-base number is the wire address.

source.title: SKE4 Steam Humidifier - Modbus Communication Module User Guide

notes: Only function codes 03, 06 and 16 are supported, so binary points (inputs, relays, flags) are 16-bit holding registers holding 0 or 1.
Scale column 'Scale N' with 'Value x N' means the raw value is the engineering value times N; this map stores the multiplier 1/N.
Temperature and capacity units follow Modbus Server Units (415002): 0 metric, 1 imperial.

Left out: product name ASCII registers 3-6 (character order unclear); Room RH Bias 6007 (typed unsigned with a negative range); Power Output Feedback Bias/Min/Max 6019-6021, Room Demand and Supply High Limit Proportional Band 6075/6077 and Boiler Idle Temperature Setpoint 6072 (scale column and example disagree); the run-time / on-time / service-time / manual calibration counters 6051-6066 and 6083-6086, which span four registers each with no stated word order.
The guide prints holding register 40672 for protocol address 6071; this is a typo for 406072 (the protocol-base column is used).
Water Temperature Bias (6013) is marked read-only in the guide even though it is a bias setting.
Default unit address is not stated; it is set from the device menu or register 0.

integration.summary: Read Room RH (6004), Humidity Demand (6044), System Power Output (6046), Boiler State (15018) and Boiler Alarm (15020). To drive the unit from the BAS set Control Profile (15005) and the demand source (15012) to Network, then write Humidity Control Network Demand (6042) or Room RH Network Reading (6028) within the Network Timeout.
integration.enable: Install the Modbus communication module, set the address in the device menu (or register 0), and choose a network control profile (15005) and sources (15008-15014) when the BAS should supply readings or demand.
integration.watchdog: Network Timeout (6081, 1-900 s, default 900 s): network-supplied values must be refreshed within this time; Network Control State (12009) shows a fault.
quirks: All points, including binary ones, are holding registers (FC03/06/16 only).
Default framing is no parity with 2 stop bits; the text calls auto baud the default while register 1 lists 19200 as its default, so check the menu.
setup: RS-485 two-wire, RTU mode; 9600-57600 baud, or auto baud detection.
Set parity/stop bits via register 2 or the Modbus Comport Config menu item.
gotchas: Some network-source registers only take effect when the matching source register is set to Network.
